caseName: Haase v. Countrywide Home Loans, Inc.
caseNameFull: Richard A. HAASE, et ux. v. COUNTRYWIDE HOME LOANS, INC.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioners allowed until November 10, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
